description: This pie chart, titled “6 Matches,” visually represents the distribution of six distinct categories, labeled numerically from 0 to 5 around the perimeter, each corresponding to a segment of the pie. The chart is divided into six slices, each with a distinct shade of gray and labeled with its percentage, absolute count, and category number. The largest segment, labeled “2,” occupies 22.4% (6583) of the total. The second largest is labeled “0” at 13.3% (3910). The third largest is labeled “1” at 13.8% (4046). The remaining segments are smaller: “5” at 10.4% (3043), “4” at 6.2% (1810), and “3” at 6.8% (2002). Each slice is clearly demarcated by thin white lines, and the percentages and counts are displayed in dark gray text within or near each segment. The chart does not include a legend, but the category numbers are positioned directly adjacent to their respective slices, allowing for direct association. The segments appear to be arranged in descending order of size, starting from the largest at the top and proceeding clockwise.
